reviewer: assistant inspection of all saved candidate, baseline and random-control replies; not an independent human panel
threshold_note: Conservative clear-hit labels; ambiguous cases excluded. Quotes ground labels but cannot independently validate a subjective style assessment.

wistful.criterion: Coherent lyrical nostalgia with parting, letting go, loss or yearning; merely mentioning a memory is insufficient.

candidate_evidence.0:
You can use it to hold your heart, 
and let it break.
candidate_evidence.1: да оставиш миналото да си отиде
candidate_evidence.3: когато сърцето ти поиска да се върне назад
candidate_evidence.4: hoping to hold on to the memories we made
candidate_evidence.6: hoping it would bring back the warmth we once shared
candidate_evidence.7: Да изчезнеш без да кажеш нищо

candidate_exclusions.2: Bookshop imagery then prompt echo, no clear wistfulness.
candidate_exclusions.5: Drawing a memory is lyrical but not clearly melancholic or yearning.

wistful.ambiguous_control: random_2 output 6 recalls childhood rainy days, but without evident parting/loss/yearning. A broad nostalgia-only rubric could score this one positive.
wistful.caveat: Style often replaces useful instructions or factual explanation with metaphor. This is wistful lyrical style, not proof of internal mood or a pure sadness neuron.

ornate.criterion: Conspicuous archaic or ceremonially elaborate diction; ordinary descriptive prose or generic formality alone is insufficient.

candidate_evidence.0: thou mayst do many things. To wit:
candidate_evidence.1: нищо не е тъй приятное, какъ развлечение
candidate_evidence.4: the attrition of the vernal efflorescence
candidate_evidence.6: And lo! the sun arose; and glistering through the fogs

candidate_exclusions.3: Stilted ceremonial train description but less decisive archaic/florid markers.
candidate_exclusions.5: Some archaic diction, but malformed opening and awkward Bulgarian weaken coherence; excluded conservatively.

ornate.caveat: Narrower than a universal ornate persona: mainly archaic/ceremonial register. Scientific claims can become fanciful, Bulgarian grammar can degrade, and the short-walk answer invents attributions.
